description: Create up to 500 QR codes from CSV data. Pro plan required. Send the CSV content as a string. Required column: target_url. Optional columns: label, format, type, foreground_color, background_color, dot_style, corner_style, frame_style, frame_text, expires_at. Returns all created QR codes.

csv_content.description: CSV content as a string with header row. Example: "target_url,label\nhttps://example.com,My QR\nhttps://other.com,Other QR"

name: bulk_create_from_csv
